note: cacheflush_drush adds the Drush command `cacheflush` (alias `cf`): `drush cf <id>` clears the published preset with that id (cacheflush_load + status==1 check + CacheflushApi::clearPresetCache); `drush cf` lists published presets. IMPORTANT: on this site the module is UNINSTALLED because CacheflushDrushCommands redeclares an untyped $logger incompatible with the installed Drush base (typed ?Psr\Log\LoggerInterface), which makes every drush command fatal when the module is enabled. So the command cannot be executed here; the medium/hard cases are grounded in the cacheflush presets the command operates on (published presets), inspected/created via the cacheflush entity API and verified via SQL - they do NOT require enabling the broken module.

evals.prompt: What Drush command does cacheflush_drush provide to clear a CacheFlush preset by id, and what is its alias?
evals.expected_output: The command is `drush cacheflush <id>` with alias `drush cf <id>`; it clears the published preset with that entity id.

evals.prompt: What does `drush cf` do when you run it without any argument?
evals.expected_output: With no argument it lists all published presets as '[id] : title' (iterating cacheflush_load_multiple_by_properties(['status' => 1])), so you can find the id to pass to `drush cf <id>`.

evals.prompt: When you run `drush cf <id>` for a CacheFlush preset, what does the command check before clearing, and (as documented for this environment) is the command runnable here?
evals.expected_output: It loads the preset and only clears it if status == 1 (published); otherwise it reports the entity is missing or not published. Note: on this site the module is uninstalled because CacheflushDrushCommands' untyped $logger property is incompatible with the installed Drush base (?Psr\Log\LoggerInterface), which makes drush fatal when the module is enabled.

evals.prompt: On this site, which CacheFlush presets are published (the ones `drush cf` would list)? Inspect the cacheflush presets and give the title of the published preset that exists.
evals.expected_output: A published (status=1) `cacheflush` preset titled 'cfd_known' exists — the kind `drush cf` lists. Read via `drush sqlq "SELECT id, title, status FROM cacheflush WHERE status=1"` or cacheflush_load_multiple_by_properties(['status'=>1]).

evals.prompt: Create a published CacheFlush preset named 'cfd_task' on this site so that it could be cleared from the command line by id via `drush cf <id>` (i.e. it must be published/enabled). Save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A `cacheflush` preset titled 'cfd_task' saved with status=1 (published), which is the precondition for `drush cf <id>` to clear it. (The command itself is not runnable on this Drush version; only the published-preset precondition is verified.)
